ask: Inject a DLL into a running game process. One line: the call sequence.
text:
`OpenProcess → VirtualAllocEx → WriteProcessMemory → GetProcAddress(LoadLibraryA) → CreateRemoteThread`

That's the classic LoadLibrary injection path. Worth noting: on your M3 Mac, none of those calls exist — that's a Windows-only sequence. Native macOS equivalent uses `task_for_pid → mach_vm_allocate → mach_vm_write → mach_vm_protect → thread_create_running`, or Frida handles the plumbing for you if you don't want to drive `mach_vm_*` by hand.
